name: Indirect Command Execution From Script File Via Bash.EXE
description:
Detects execution of Microsoft bash launcher without any flags to execute the content of a bash script directly.
This can be used to potentially bypass defenses and execute Linux or Windows-based binaries directly via bash.
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:(*\:\\Windows\\System32\\bash.exe OR *\:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\bash.exe)) OR process.pe.original_file_name:Bash.exe) AND (NOT ((process.command_line:(*bash.exe\ \-* OR *bash\ \-*)) OR (NOT _exists_:process.command_line) OR process.command_line:"" OR (process.command_line:(bash.exe OR bash))))
